scope: User-operated Desk rehearsal on temporary SEN0390 application firmware; single live-monitor observation and user-reported light response
user_reported_flow: Connected the prewired SEN0390 with power off; OLED started after USB reconnection.
Connected to the Desk, matched SEN0390 to the diagnostic firmware, and obtained a Gemini datasheet draft after retrying a service error.
Reported that the draft identified address 0x4A and mentioned a register conflict.
Prepared a draft using the existing three-device profile, 0x4A, SDA GPIO0, SCL GPIO1 and EN GPIO5.
Reviewed all four devices, applied and saved the profile, and confirmed the OLED remained on.
Reported a fresh light reading that increased when illuminated with a phone flashlight and decreased afterward.

desk_observation.kind: single accessibility snapshot; not continuous monitoring

issues_observed: The first Desk instance was network-restricted; a restarted instance reached Gemini, which initially returned HTTP 503 before a successful retry.
Background polling briefly disabled user controls. A local code change and host test addressed this; the user reported steady buttons after reload.
After successful draft generation, the user repeated the action because the success notice was away from the control; the resulting duplicate attempt reported too many queues.
restoration: Not yet performed at the time of this record; diagnostic firmware and revision 923 were active and the Desk was connected.
limitations: The user did not report numerical before, during and after flashlight readings; the observed response is qualitative.
The light reading is not calibrated, and one snapshot does not establish long-term sensor, radar or combined-system reliability.
The initial radar communication and supply observations remain unresolved; this rehearsal is not full four-device acceptance.
The AI output is unreviewed, and this is not evidence of general extraction accuracy or new-device driver generation.
The temporary firmware is not the normal supported release and this rehearsal does not qualify whole-system static memory or wireless services.
